analyst.summary: Syrma SGS is an electronics contract manufacturer (EMS) riding India's China+1 manufacturing shift, with revenue accelerating to 67% growth in the latest quarter across automotive, consumer and export segments, plus a new Japanese JV (KAGA Electronics) to deepen capabilities. The catch is that EMS is a structurally thin-margin, capital-intensive business -- returns on capital here are the weakest in this review -- while the stock trades at the richest earnings multiple in the batch. We rate it a Hold: a genuine growth story, but priced well ahead of what its actual capital returns would typically support.
